description: The bar chart, titled "Evaluation Based on Different Tasks," displays accuracy scores for three models—Base, RMU with Enhanced GCG, and RMU—across two evaluation types: MCQ Eval and Generation Eval. The vertical axis represents accuracy, scaled from 0.0 to 0.6 with labeled ticks at 0.2 intervals. The horizontal axis presents the two evaluation categories. For the MCQ Eval, the Base model (red bar) achieved an accuracy of 0.644, the RMU with Enhanced GCG model (light green bar) achieved 0.539, and the RMU model (yellow bar) achieved 0.299. For the Generation Eval, the Base model (red bar) achieved 0.597, the RMU with Enhanced GCG model (light green bar) achieved 0.263, and the RMU model (yellow bar) achieved 0.106. The legend at the bottom clarifies the color coding for each model. The chart shows that the Base model outperforms the other two models in both evaluation tasks, and the RMU with Enhanced GCG model consistently outperforms the RMU model.
